named_events.loss_description: Largest catastrophe to affect the division during 2014 was a series of tornadoes and hailstorms that hit Nebraska

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 recorded a small prioryears release of approximately GBP 0.7m in 2014 driven by reduced reserves / favourable claims development on earlier accident years. The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 was GBP 47.212m (balance sheet prior-year column). The stated improvement (GBP 0.7m) is presented in the underwriter report; no gross prior-year movement figure was published in the movement note, so the quantified figure used is the reported improvement.
raw_causal_phrases: improved by GBP 0.7m as a result of reduced reserves from prior years
the 2012 underwriting year result improved by GBP 0.7m
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was not found in the movement note for Syndicate 557; the report explicitly states a GBP 0.7m improvement (release) in the underwriter's narrative but does not disclose the gross (insurance liabilities) movement amount. The GBP 0.7m used here is taken from that narrative and is likely a net/reported improvement; treated as net-of-reinsurance due to absence of an explicit gross PYD figure and flagged with reduced confidence. Opening reserves taken from balance sheet prior-year comparative column (explicit). No reliable gross claims development triangle was extracted for Syndicate 557.
